TERMINATION / CANCELLATION OF LEASE

Office or Division: Legazpi City Public Market Office
Classification: Simple Transaction
Type of Transaction: Government to Citizen (G2C)
Who may Avail: Registered market stallholders who wish to terminate their lease

Checklist of Requirements

• Formal Letter of Request for Termination addressed to the City Market Administrator
• Photocopy of Lease Contract
• Valid Government-issued ID
• Clearance of outstanding financial obligations (if any)

Service Procedure

   required documents           documents               None     5 minutes
                                Issue Statement of                               Market Officer-in-Charge
2. Settle any unpaid rental or  Account and accept   Based on    10 minutes
   arrears (if applicable)      payment                arrears
                                Conduct inspection               15 minutes
3. Surrender stall and keys     and accept turnover     None

• Total Processing Time: 45 minutes
